name: John
source:
Despite his intimidating size and supernatural strength, John is the balm to his two more excitable colleagues. He is cool, collected, kind, and is known as an all-around solid fellow. He and Robin share a deep bond of camaraderie, but his relationship with his half-brother Will is strained. Behind his calm front, John hides a sly sense of humour and deep scars from his past. Will his strong desire to protect those he loves lead to his own downfall?

Strengths: Martial arts, loyalty, kindness, selflessness
Flaws: Terrible card cheat, overprotective, hates uncertainty
Likes: Music, family and friends, outdoorsmanship
Dislikes: Bullies, risk-taking, helplessness

[From [url=https://velvet-cupcake-games.itch.io/made-marion]itch.io[/url]]

[spoiler]Real name: Okoro[/spoiler]
